statements.quote: Together with Microsoft prepayment ($1.9bn) covers 95% of GPU-related capex
statements.notes: Bullet fragment, not a full sentence. It refers to GPU-related (AI Cloud) capex for the Microsoft contract but gives no capex amount. 95% is the share of that capex covered by financing, not a share of capex going to AI, so it is recorded as qualitative. The $3.6bn financing and $1.9bn prepayment are funding sources, not capex amounts, and are not used to derive one. No year is stated in the sentence.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes operating expenses (R&D, infrastructure, headcount) to AI. AI Cloud Services cost of revenue appears only as a quarterly table line item, not as a statement about AI spend.
